svg.title: Three kinds of flow, and the ladder that chooses among automation platforms
svg.desc: Top row, three boxes. Cloud flow: built in Power Automate, a fixed path of connector actions, billed with Power Automate licences and Power Platform requests, the default for deterministic automation. Agent flow: built in Copilot Studio on the standard harness with the same designer concepts (trigger, actions, expressions, connection references, solutions), deterministic, with AI actions and human-in-the-loop actions available, billed per action with Copilot Studio capacity, can be a tool of an agent; a cloud flow can be converted to an agent flow one way. Workflow: built in Copilot Studio on the GitHub Copilot harness, a new canvas with prompt nodes, agent nodes and node-level testing, billed with Copilot Credits, can be a tool of an agent; a cloud flow cannot be converted into it; confirm its release status before production. Below, the design ladder, first match wins: 1 must the rule hold for every caller or inside the transaction? then server logic, plug-in or custom API. 2 needs code, libraries or very high volume? then Azure Function. 3 called by an agent? then an agent flow as a tool that answers within 100 seconds, or accept and work in the background when longer. 4 must a model plan the steps? then a workflow if the new experience is allowed, otherwise an agent flow with bounded AI actions. 5 one bounded AI step, or Copilot Studio capacity? agent flow. 6 otherwise a cloud flow. A side note lists what all three flows share: triggers, actions, expressions, connections, run history, the design questions.
svg.text: Three kinds of flow in 2026, and how to choose a home for an automation
A fixed path of connector actions
Can be a tool of an agent
Built in Copilot Studio, new canvas
Can be a tool of an agent
No conversion from a cloud flow
The design ladder: the first “yes” decides
1 Must the rule hold for every caller, or inside the data transaction?
→ Server logic: plug-in or custom API (not an automation)
2 Needs code, libraries, heavy work, or more than about 100,000 runs a day?
→ Agent flow as a tool (answer within 100 s; longer: accept, work in the background)
4 Must a model plan the steps (the path cannot be written down)?
→ Workflow, if the new experience is allowed; otherwise an agent flow with AI actions
5 One bounded AI step, or Copilot Studio capacity?
A trigger and at least one action
who starts it, who is it,
what is fixed and what is judged,
how long, what if it fails,
how does it get to Production
